english.note: Use 議員 as the all-purpose choice when the context already makes clear that the person is a lawmaker.

exampleSentences.english: That lawmaker said they would explain everything within this month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰位議員話會喺今個月內交代清楚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 wai6 ji5 jyun4 waa6 wui5 hai2 gam1 go3 jyut6 noi6 gaau1 doi6 cing1 co2

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term when the political context makes it clear that the person is a legislator.

exampleSentences.english: This legislator made a very reasonable speech in the council.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位議員喺議會入面發言，好有道理。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 wai6 ji5 jyun4 hai2 ji5 wui2 jap6 min6 faat3 jin4 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5

english.note: Use this for a deputy who is a member of a legislature, including the French National Assembly or the Dáil.

exampleSentences.english: This deputy proposed an amendment in the legislature.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位議員喺國會提出咗修例。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wai2 ji5 jyun4 hai2 gwok3 wui6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 sau1 lai6

english.note: Use this specifically for a member of a legislative or elected governing body rather than a general delegate.

exampleSentences.english: That representative, a councillor, proposed a plan at the district council.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰位議員喺區議會提出咗個方案。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 wai2 ji5 jyun4 hai2 keoi1 ji5 wui6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 go3 fong1 on3
